user.title: Connect your LazyPot account
user.description: Paste the integration token from your LazyPot account settings (website or app) — this is not your LazyPot login password.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your LazyPot account
reauth_confirm.description: Your LazyPot integration token was rejected. It may have expired or been revoked. Generate a new token in your LazyPot account settings (website or app) and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: Token was rejected. Generate a new one from your LazyPot account settings.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the LazyPot smart-home API.

abort.already_configured: This LazyPot account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different LazyPot account. Use a token from the account this integration was set up with.
